resources.string: Remove embedded video from Samsung Motion Photos, keeping only the still image. Scans your gallery and WhatsApp folders.
Save as copy — write stripped images to Pictures/StrippedPhotos/
Overwrite originals — replace files in place (requires full storage access)
Tap "Scan" to find Samsung Motion Photos on this device, including images received via WhatsApp. For best WhatsApp coverage, grant "All files access" when processing.
Storage read permission is needed to scan for Motion Photos. Please grant the permission and try again.
To overwrite original files, the app needs "All files access" permission. You will be taken to the system settings screen to grant it.
To write files, the app needs "All files access" permission. You will be taken to the system settings screen to grant it.
Full storage access was not granted. Switch to "Save as copy" mode, or grant the permission in Settings.
WhatsApp stores received photos in a protected folder. Grant "All files access" to include those photos in the scan. You can skip this and still scan your camera roll and gallery.
